description: White canvas; grey rounded question box at top: 'Q. I heard that bananas are radioactive. If they are radioactive, then they radiate energy. How many bananas would you need to power a house? - Kang Ji'; stick figure at left holding a paper; empty blackboard rectangle at right.
Single activity frame: one outlined banana appears in the centre of the empty blackboard; rest unchanged. Pop-on inferred from one-frame change.
Blackboard holds one outlined banana at centre; stick figure with paper at left; question box at top unchanged.
Single activity frame: black-and-white radiation trefoil warning triangle appears at right of blackboard; banana shifts slightly left/up versus previous hold.
Blackboard holds one banana (left-centre) and one radiation trefoil warning triangle (right); figure with paper at left.
Small wavy radiation squiggles appear around the banana in progressive stages (a few at 4.29s, many by 4.42s, ring complete by 4.54s); banana is also slightly larger/moved to centre.
Banana ringed by about 20 black wavy squiggles, trefoil triangle at right; figure with paper at left.
Single activity frame: single banana replaced by a bunch of about four bananas, still ringed by squiggles; onset UNRESOLVED (one tile).
Bunch of bananas surrounded by wavy squiggles, trefoil triangle at right, figure with paper at left; question box at top.
Single activity frame: stick figure's paper is replaced by a single banana held in its hand; arm position changes.
Figure at left now holds one banana at its side; blackboard shows banana bunch with squiggles and trefoil.
Squiggles around banana bunch fade out progressively over the activity (9.67s full, 9.75s grey/faint, 9.875s only a few short tick marks remain); bunch shrinks slightly.
Blackboard shows banana bunch with only a few short tick marks and trefoil triangle; figure at left holds a banana at its side.
Single activity frame: figure's arm raises the banana up beside its head and the banana is now on fire (small flame outline above it); onset UNRESOLVED.
Figure at left extends an arm holding a burning banana (flame at tip, grey/black outline); blackboard shows banana bunch and trefoil.

Hard cut to red full-frame title card: black silhouette of a dinosaur-like creature crushing a satellite at top, white 'xkcd's what if?' with 'THE VIDEO SERIES'. Card static in the sampled frames 14.0-15.6s, then cuts to white canvas with banana at 16.0s. Peak change is the cut; no motion visible between samples.
White canvas; single large outlined banana at upper-left; no text; no character.
Hand-lettered text types on left-to-right at right of banana: '~0' at 16.875s, '~0.45g POTAS' (clipped) at 17.0s, full '~0.45g POTASSIUM' by 17.08s.
Banana at left, one line of text '~0.45g POTASSIUM' upper right of it.
Second text line writes on below the first, left-to-right: '~0' then '~0.00005g POTI' (clipped) then '~0.00005g POTASSIUM-40'.
Banana at left; two text lines right of it: '~0.45g POTASSIUM' and '~0.00005g POTASSIUM-40'. Layout shifted lower than previous hold.
Single activity frame: hard cut to white canvas with two small stick figures lower-centre, a dark-haired figure on left and a bald-headed figure on right holding a banana peel/banana.
Two stick figures lower-centre: dark-haired figure at left gesturing, plain-headed figure at right holding a half-peeled banana. No text.

Speech text writes on above the left figure: 'IT'S OKAY, IT'S NO MORE' then three further lines to 'IT'S OKAY, IT'S NO MORE RADIATION THAN YOU'D GET FROM STANDING NEXT TO A BANANA.' with small tail line to speaker.
Four-line speech text upper-left with tail to the dark-haired figure; second figure at right holds banana. No thought bubble yet.

Fades in a thought bubble upper-right reading 'DON'T STAND NEXT TO BANANAS. GOT IT.' (grey at 27.75s, darker 27.875s, black by 28.0s); right figure's arm drops and the banana falls to the ground as a small peel (faded then solid).
Both figures; thought bubble 'DON'T STAND NEXT TO BANANAS. GOT IT.' above right figure; banana drops mid-air near centre with tiny motion marks.
Single activity frame: banana peel now lying on the ground, lower than in prior hold; onset UNRESOLVED.
Long hold: two figures, speech text, thought bubble, peel resting on the ground at bottom-centre.
Red scribble/hatching marks drawn over the banana peel on the ground (peel black at 34.79s, red scribble present by 34.92s). Red colour used.
Same scene with red scribble crossing out the banana peel at bottom; speech text and thought bubble unchanged.

Single activity frame: hard cut to a grey book cover at left: 'CRC HANDBOOK OF RADIATION MEASUREMENT AND PROTECTION ALLEN BRODSKY', labels 'SECTION A VOLUME II: BIOLOGICAL AND MATHEMATICAL INFORMATION' and 'CRC PRESS'; right side empty.
Grey book cover at left; white canvas at right empty.

Single activity frame: bordered table appears at right: 'TABLE A. 3.7.12 ESTIMATES OF POTASSIUM-40 CONTENTS OF FOODS', columns 'FOOD GROUPS' and 'ESTIMATED 40K pCi/kg FOOD', row 'BANANAS 3520', footnote '*pCi : picoCURIE' below.
Book at left, table at right with header and one row 'BANANAS 3520'; footnote '*pCi : picoCURIE'. Canvas appears slightly shifted/larger framing versus G0034.
New table row writes on below BANANAS: 'C' then 'COCONUTS' then '6400' in the value column.
Table rows 'BANANAS 3520' and 'COCONUTS 6400'; book at left.
Rows write on sequentially: 'PE' then 'PEANUTS' with '5820', then 'SWEET POTATO' growing to 'SWEET POTATOES 4450' by 44.75s. Layout scrolls up slightly (rows shift upward in later tiles).
Table with four rows: BANANAS 3520, COCONUTS 6400, PEANUTS 5820, SWEET POTATOES 4450; book at left.

Single activity frame: hard cut to white canvas with labels 'BANANA' and 'PIZZA' at top; small banana and large oval pizza drawn with radiation tick marks; below each '15 40K DECAYS PER SECOND' and '45 40K DECAYS PER SECOND'.
BANANA, PIZZA columns with radiating tick marks and decay counts '15' and '45' '40K DECAYS PER SECOND'.
Single activity frame: third column appears at right: label 'YOU' above a stick figure wearing a knit cap with tick marks, '3500 40K DECAYS PER SECOND' below; existing columns unchanged.
Three columns: BANANA 15, PIZZA 45, YOU 3500 '40K DECAYS PER SECOND'; columns spaced slightly differently than at G0042.
Single activity frame: hard cut to white canvas with title 'POTASSIUM-40' at top and a grey-and-white nucleus cluster drawing below it.
Title 'POTASSIUM-40' with nucleus cluster of grey and white spheres centred.
Text types on below the nucleus left-to-right: '1.24' then '1.248 BILLION YE' then '1.248 BILLION YEAR HALF-LIFE'.
Title 'POTASSIUM-40', nucleus, and caption '1.248 BILLION YEAR HALF-LIFE' (layout positioned higher than in G0045).
Small burst marks appear on right of nucleus, then a wavy line grows rightward ending in an arrowhead (squiggle arrow completes by 58.92s).
Nucleus with a wavy arrow pointing right; title and half-life caption unchanged.
Single activity frame: hard cut to white canvas with '40K' label above a nucleus at far left; nothing else.
Nucleus labelled '40K' at left; empty canvas to the right.
Single activity frame: arrow labelled 'EVERY SECOND' and an empty diamond decision shape with a tiny coin mark near its top appear to the right of nucleus.
Nucleus '40K' -> arrow 'EVERY SECOND' -> empty diamond with tiny coin mark near top.
Single activity frame: a cluster of about 20 small outlined dice appears inside the diamond; the tiny coin mark is no longer clearly visible. Camera view shifts (diagram moves lower in the tile).
Nucleus, arrow, and diamond containing many small dice and a small coin mark at top.
Single activity frame: a small red oval mark appears at the lower right inside the diamond among the dice (red used).
Diamond with dice and a small red oval at lower right; nucleus and arrow at left. Canvas framing shifted upward versus G0056.

Diamond with dice; elbow arrow from the top to the right labelled 'YES'.
Single activity frame: nucleus with burst marks and a wavy emission line appears at the end of the YES arrow at upper right.
Flowchart: nucleus 40K -> EVERY SECOND -> diamond -> YES -> emitting nucleus at upper right.
Single activity frame: return loop arrow added from bottom of the diamond leftward and up to the 40K nucleus, labelled 'NO'.
Complete flowchart with YES branch to emitting nucleus and NO loop arrow returning to 40K nucleus; footing of the frame has tall loop at bottom.

Single activity frame: hard cut to a large outlined banana with '40K' above it, arrow below labelled 'GAZILLIONS*', an arrow pointing right, and a footnote at bottom: 'TECHNICAL NOTE: LIFE IS TOO SHORT TO SIT AROUND COUNTING ZEROS AND THEN LOOKING UP THE LATIN PREFIXES FOR BIG NUMBERS'.
Banana with '40K' and 'GAZILLIONS*' labels, right-pointing arrow, technical-note footnote at bottom (second line clipped at lower edge).
Single activity frame: arrow now labelled '10-15/s' leading to a nucleus labelled '40/19 K'; whole group shifted left and down slightly; onset UNRESOLVED.
Banana -> '10-15/s' -> nucleus '40/19 K'; footnote at bottom.

Banana -> 10-15/s -> nucleus 40/19 K with burst marks and 'e- (or gamma)' to its right; footnote at bottom.
Single activity frame: an elbow arrow labelled '90%' rises to a nucleus labelled '40/20 Ca' at upper right.
Nucleus 40/19 K with 90% arrow to 40/20 Ca at upper right.
Single activity frame: second branch arrow labelled '10%' goes down to a nucleus '40/18 Ar' at lower right; camera framing shifted downward.
Branching diagram: 40/19 K splits to 40/20 Ca (90%) and 40/18 Ar (10%); banana at left; footnote at bottom.
A jagged zigzag arrow grows rightward from the 'e- (or gamma)' label across the right of the diagram: small tick at 83.29s, long zigzag to arrowhead by 83.375s.
Zigzag arrow with burst marks crossing the right of the diagram above the 40/18 Ar nucleus; rest unchanged.
Single activity frame: large stick-figure head and torso appear at lower right, overlapping the 40/18 Ar nucleus and footnote text.
Large figure head and body at lower right in front of the diagram (jokey bonking visual); diagram unchanged.

Detailed outlined Mars rover at lower-left; plain white elsewhere.

Rover with black '238 Pu' on its power block; nothing else.
Single activity frame: radiation arrows radiating from the power block appear, and text '~2,000,000,000,000,000 DECAYS/SECOND' above the rover; onset of text UNRESOLVED.
Rover with radiating arrows at its rear; text '~2,000,000,000,000,000 DECAYS/SECOND' above.

Rover; text lines '~2,000,000,000,000,000 DECAYS/SECOND' and '~2000 W' above.

Rover with '~2000 W' on left; banana icon with '~15 DECAYS/SECOND' at right.

Rover left with '~2000 W'; banana right with '~15 DECAYS/SECOND' and '0.0000000000032 W'.

Figure on stepladder holding bananas over a hopper machine with trefoil; pipe to the right.

Small ladder figure and machine at lower-left; large house at right.

Grey banana pile hanging from the top of the frame above the house, figure and machine at lower-left with an exclamation mark.

Map view: grey banana pile covering Manhattan with labels UPSTATE, NJ, MANHATTAN, BROOKLYN, STATEN ISLAND, BANANAS.

Figure at left; blackboard with banana at left and 'POTASSIUM-40: ~0.00005g' at right.

Blackboard with banana in burst outline and nutrition list BANANA, CALORIES ~100, POTASSIUM-40 ~0.00005g, SUGAR ~15g, FAT ~1g, CARBOHYDRATES ~27g, FIBER ~3g; figure at left.

Figure, banana piles, small wooden banana-burning power shed with smokestack, power pole with line to the right.

Small banana burner with smoking chimney and pole at lower left, connected to the large house at right.

Figure shrugging at right; peeled banana in the air beside it; grey mound over the skyline at left.
